comments.note: localization-tools-config.php was updated to remove a redundant addSourceFolder() call. Localization::init() already registers the 'application-localization' source, so re-adding it created duplicate sources with different IDs (md5 of unnormalized vs normalized sourcesFolder paths), causing 0 hashes for the config-file source. Fix: rely on init() for source registration.

Application-utils source (from mistralys/application-utils-core init()) is also exported to vendor/. This is expected per the plan ('for each registered source') but worth noting for downstream consumers.

summary: All methods correctly typed and follow ReleaseBuilder pattern
Path normalization strategy is sound and verified working on Windows
composer.json correctly updated with export-translations script
localization-tools-config.php fix (removing redundant addSourceFolder) is a valid and necessary correction

comments.note: Code is clean and well-structured. loadConfig() correctly implements the 3-step config resolution. getUniqueSources() normalizes storageFolder via realpath() before deduplication — correct fix for the init() duplicate source issue. getFilePaths() path normalization handles Windows backslashes and /../ segments correctly with realpath() primary + manual fallback. buildEntry() correctly handles nullable getText().

Minor: getFilePaths() manual path collapse for the empty-segment case assumes absolute paths start with an empty segment after splitting on '/'. On Windows, paths start with a drive letter (e.g. 'F:') so the collision with empty-segment check is not triggered. Functionally correct but the comment could be clearer.
